extension.description: Rich Markdown preview with LaTeX/Mermaid support, theme-aware, editable comments sent to Copilot Chat.
command.showSource.title: Markdown Rich Preview: Edit Source
command.showPreview.title: Markdown Rich Preview: Open Preview
command.clearComments.title: Markdown Rich Preview: Clear Comments
configuration.title: Markdown Rich Preview
configuration.fontFamily.description: UI text font family used in the preview. Leave empty to follow the editor font.
configuration.chineseFontFamily.descript: Font family used for Chinese (CJK) text in the preview. Leave empty to follow the OS system font.
configuration.codeFontFamily.description: Font family used for code blocks in the preview. Leave empty to follow the editor's (monospace) font.
configuration.fontSize.description: Font size (px) used in the preview. Set to 0 to follow the editor font size.
configuration.lineHeight.description: Line height used in the preview.
configuration.openAsDefault.description: Open .md files with this preview by default instead of the native text editor.
